title: cad-to-gazebo CAD IR v1
description: Versioned contract for config/cad_manifest.json, the intermediate representation between the CAD (Mechanism / STEP import) and the SDF emitters. Validated fail-fast by cad.ir_schema before any write and in CI. The `schema` tag selects the version: a document carrying a different tag is a different contract and must be migrated, never silently reinterpreted.

schema.description: IR version tag. Bumped per breaking change; additive sections do not bump it.

bodies.description: Rigid bodies (SDF links). Each carries its own frame pose, the solids it is made of and the per-solid material/mass/inertia.

joints.description: DOF topology: one entry per FreeCAD Assembly joint that maps to an SDF joint, in CAD document order.

skipped_joints.description: CAD joints deliberately not emitted (unresolvable references, mappings merged away): every skip must carry its reason.

frames.description: Local coordinate systems / LCS attached to a body. A joint origin is one of them; sensor and jet anchors mount on one of them.

anchors.description: Mount points for sensors, jets and mooring fairleads. An anchor is a named pose, not a body: it never appears as an SDF link.

sensors.description: Sensor declarations carried through to the emitter (SDF/URDF sensor blocks, ROS topics).

links.description: LEGACY (pre-v1) flat link list. Still valid so that a pre-v1 manifest does not fail on upgrade, but new writes must use `bodies`. cad.ir_schema.migrate_legacy() folds it into `bodies` and drops it. See docs/ir-v1.md.

name.description: IR identifier shared by SDF, URDF and ROS: lowercase snake_case, no leading/trailing/doubled separators, produced only by cad.naming.sanitize().

pose7.description: [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw] in SI (metres, unit quaternion), local to the parent frame.

material.description: Material card resolved by material_props.py: a named card plus the visual colours. Extra keys are preserved for the emitter.

meta.description: Closed contract: these are the fields another repository matches on. Unknown keys are rejected so a producer cannot smuggle an undocumented field into the shared IR.

generator.description: Producer that wrote the file (freecad_exporter.py, create_demo_model.py, step_import.py, ...).

emitter_version.description: <package>/<version> of the IR emitter, e.g. cad-to-gazebo/0.1.0.

device_type.description: WEC device class the model belongs to (point_absorber, oscillating_surge_converter, oscillating_water_column, overtopping, transmission, generic, ...).

source_hash.description: sha256:<64 hex> of the source CAD file, or "" when the model has no CAD source (demo).

units.description: Unit contract of every coordinate, mass and angle in this document.

created.description: ISO-8601 local timestamp of the emission (second resolution).

root.description: Name of the kinematic root body (the grounded CAD component). Must exist in `bodies`.

label.description: Raw CAD label, kept for traceability. Never used as an identifier.

fc_type.description: FreeCAD Assembly::Joint type (Fixed, Revolute, Slider, Cylindrical, Distance, Ball, Screw, ...).

parent.description: Parent body name (the frame the joint hangs from).

child.description: Child body name (the DOF it drives).

origin.description: Joint coordinate system (JCS) pose in the parent body frame.

axis.description: DOF axis, expressed in the JCS. Non-zero.

activated.description: False = the CAD joint is carried but produces no SDF joint.

limits.description: Absolute DOF limits in SI (already converted from mm/deg by the producer) plus the current DOF coordinate used to rebase them onto the SDF zero.

kind.description: What mounts here. sensor/jet are the C4 mount points; mooring carries a fairlead.

direction.description: Mount/effort direction in the anchor frame.

type.description: Sensor class as the emitter knows it (imu, gps, camera, force_torque, pressure, encoder, ...).

topic.description: ROS topic the reading is published on.

legacy_link.description: Pre-v1 flat link: it is both the link and its single geometry entry.
